question: A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. H sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between H and I when counted from the left of H. Only three people sit between D and C. A sits to the immediate right of G. How many people sit between D and G when counted from the right of G?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) H sits to the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/369ac6fd0aad3b900d62bb110c4e780eaacc4ac8abe5a24120790902d8cb0a04.png] 

2) Only three people sit between D and C.

3) Only three people sit between H and I when counted from the left of H.</
